mapper.update: update t_order_info set order_status = 'ACTIVE', pay_status = 'PAID', paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, paid_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where order_no = #{orderNo} and order_status = 'WAIT_PAY'
update t_order_info set order_status = 'CLOSED', fulfillment_status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where order_no = #{orderNo} and order_status = 'WAIT_PAY'

update t_order_info o set o.refund_status = ( select case when coalesce(sum(i.refund_frozen_amount), 0) > 0 then 'REFUNDING' when coalesce(sum(i.refunded_amount), 0) <= 0 then 'NONE' when coalesce(sum(i.refunded_amount), 0) >= o.paid_amount then 'FULL_REFUNDED' else 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED' end from t_order_item i where i.order_no = o.order_no ), o.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where o.order_no = #{orderNo}
